title: How a Godly Man Leads the Table When It Turns Into Gossip
caption:
Somebody's name comes up and the tone in the room drops a register. That's the moment. Not the lecture after, the moment itself.

A godly man doesn't out-talk the drift. He names it. He asks the one question that ends it: "have you said that to him?" And if it's serious enough, he says the costly sentence first: "I don't think I should hear this without him here."

Proverbs 16:28 doesn't call that drama. It calls it wisdom.

Leadership doesn't wait for a title. It shows up the next time a name comes up when he's not in the room.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #leadership #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
